Privacy.title: Privacy and Prototype Notice
Privacy.prototypeText: ClujParticipa is a prototype and coalition-building tool, not a production voting system. All data, votes, and interactions are for demonstration and feedback purposes only.
Privacy.dataText: Submitted ideas, comments, and support votes are stored to demonstrate the platform's functionality. Data may be reset or modified during the prototype phase without notice.
Privacy.votesText: Support votes do not represent binding decisions. They indicate community interest within the prototype and carry no official weight. Any future binding participation process would require verified identity and a separate mandate.
Privacy.anonymityText: Voting and commenting use an anonymous participant token generated in your browser. Only a SHA-256 hash of this token is stored on the server. The raw token is never transmitted or recorded. This prevents duplicate votes without identifying individuals.
Privacy.oauthText: You may choose to sign in with a Google or Facebook account. Upon sign-in, the provider shares only your name and email address with the platform. We do not store provider passwords or access tokens. Your login identity is linked to an internal participant hash, not the raw Google/Facebook ID. This prevents duplicate votes across devices for authenticated users. Voting remains non-binding even for authenticated users, as no municipal eligibility verification is performed.
Privacy.moderationText: Submitted ideas and comments may be moderated. Moderation events are recorded and visible in the public audit trail. Comments may be hidden if they violate community guidelines.
Privacy.identityText: A future production system would require identity verification to enable binding participation. The current prototype does not collect or verify personal identity. This limitation is intentional for the pilot phase.
Privacy.controllerText: The data controller for this platform is the Cluj-Napoca Municipal Hall (Primăria Municipiului Cluj-Napoca), responsible for the processing of your personal data.
Privacy.legalBasisText: We process your personal data based on: (a) your consent when you sign in via Google or Facebook; (b) the legitimate interest of operating a civic participation prototype; (c) legal obligations where applicable.
Privacy.rightsText: Under GDPR, you have the right to: access your personal data; request rectification of inaccurate data; request erasure of your data ('right to be forgotten'); request data portability; and object to certain types of processing. To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@clujparticipa.digital or use the data deletion page.
Privacy.retentionPolicyText: Personal data (name, email) is retained for the duration of your account. Upon deletion, all personal data is removed within 30 days. Anonymized participation data (vote hashes) is retained indefinitely for platform integrity. Deletion request records are retained for 2 years for audit purposes.
Privacy.dpoText: For any questions about data protection or to exercise your rights, contact us at privacy@clujparticipa.digital. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
Privacy.dataDeletionText: You can request the deletion of your personal data at any time. Facebook users can trigger automatic deletion from their Facebook settings. All users can also request deletion by email. See the data deletion page for details.

DataDeletion.title: Data deletion
DataDeletion.intro: You can request the deletion of all your personal data from ClujParticipa.
DataDeletion.facebookText: If you signed in with Facebook, you can request data deletion directly from your Facebook app settings under Settings > Apps and Websites. This sends an automatic deletion request to our platform.
DataDeletion.emailText: You can also request data deletion by sending an email to {email} with the subject 'Data Deletion Request'. Please include the email address associated with your account.
DataDeletion.whatIsDeletedText: Upon deletion, we remove your user account, login credentials, participant identity, and all associated sessions. Your votes and comments are retained anonymously (identified only by participant hash, not your personal identity).
DataDeletion.retentionNote: Some anonymized data may be retained for platform integrity (preventing duplicate votes, maintaining comment threads). This data cannot be linked back to you personally.
DataDeletion.confirmationText: If you have a confirmation code, enter it below to check the status of your deletion request.
DataDeletion.statusPending: Your deletion request is being processed.
DataDeletion.statusCompleted: Your data has been successfully deleted. Confirmation code: {code}
DataDeletion.statusFailed: There was an issue processing your deletion request. Please contact us by email.
DataDeletion.statusNotFound: No deletion request found for this confirmation code.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.prototypeText: ClujParticipa is a prototype and coalition-building tool, not a production voting system. These terms apply exclusively to the prototype phase and may be changed without notice.
Terms.scopeText: The platform allows users to submit neighborhood improvement proposals for Cluj-Napoca, support existing proposals, comment, and follow status updates. All functionality is for demonstration purposes only.
Terms.accountsText: You may use the platform anonymously (with a locally generated token) or sign in with a Google or Facebook account. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential. You must not use another person's account.
Terms.contentText: Ideas, comments, and other content you submit must be respectful and must not violate applicable law. We reserve the right to moderate or remove content that violates community guidelines. We do not guarantee that any submitted content will be published or maintained on the platform.
Terms.votingText: Support votes on this platform are exclusively for prototype purposes and do not represent official or binding decisions. Any binding participation process would require identity verification and a separate mandate.
Terms.moderationText: The administration team may change idea statuses and moderate comments. All moderation actions are recorded and visible in the public audit trail.
Terms.liabilityText: The platform is provided as-is, without warranties of any kind. The Cluj-Napoca Municipal Hall is not liable for any losses or damages arising from use of the platform. Data may be reset or modified during the prototype phase.
Terms.changesText: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be posted on this page. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
Terms.governingText: These terms are governed by the laws of Romania. Any disputes shall be resolved by the competent courts in Cluj-Napoca, Romania.
Terms.privacyText: For information about how we process personal data, please see our privacy page.
